subject: general
question:
Match the lakes in column A with their countries in column B.

 
 

 
 **Column-A**
 
 **Column-B**
 
 

 i.
 Lake Baikal
 a.
 Uganda and Tanzania
 
 

 ii.
 Lake Superior
 b.
 Canada and USA
 
 

 iii.
 Loch Lomond
 c.
 Scotland
 
 

 iv.
 Lake Victoria
 d.
 Russia

options.text: i - a, ii - b, iii - c, iv - d
i - a, ii - c, iii - b, iv - d
i - d, ii - b, iii - c, iv - a
i - a, ii - d, iii - b, iv - c

solution:
The correct answer is__** i - d, ii - b, iii - c, iv - a.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**__**Lake Baikal:**__

__
 
• Baikal lake one of the **deepest lakes** in the world located in the **mountainous region of Siberia, Russia **north of Mongoloid boundary.
 
• It is a** freshwater lake** which remains **frozen for half of the year** from January till May.
 
• Also known as the **Galapagos of Russia**, its depth is 1700m.

**Lake Superior:**__

__
 
• It is the largest of the Great Lakes of North America and among freshwater lakes.
 
• It is the **world's largest lake by surface area **and the third-largest by volume.
 
• It is bounded on the east and north by Ontario (Canada), on the west by Minnesota (U.S.), and on the south by Wisconsin and Michigan (U.S.).

**Loch Lomond:**__

__
 
• Loch Lomond is a **freshwater lake** situated in Scotland.
 
• The lake crosses the Highland Boundary Fault, often considered the** boundary between the lowlands of Central Scotland and the Highlands.**

**Lake Victoria:**__

 
• Lake Victoria is at the** border of Uganda, Kenya and Tanzania.**
 
• It is the world’s largest tropical lake and the **second largest freshwater lake**.
 
• Lake Victoria touches the Equator in its northern side. It is also the **source of primary stream of White Nile River**.
